name: com.myradostudio/novaposhta
title: Nova Poshta (unofficial)
description: Unofficial read-only server for Nova Poshta: tracking, branches, lockers, delivery estimates.

environmentVariables.name: NOVAPOSHTA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal API key from the Nova Poshta business cabinet. Optional: the public methods the server uses answered without a key when it was written.

environmentVariables.name: NOVAPOSHTA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the Nova Poshta API. Change it only for testing against your own stand-in.
